decisive_items: Revealed endometrial glands consisting of a single layer of monomorphous cuboidal cells with an endometrial stroma
A subcutaneous nodule of approximately 1 cm diameter was present under the hypogastrium.
a linear scar was observed in the lower-left abdominal region
response.rationale: Histopathology confirms endometrial tissue in a subcutaneous abdominal nodule near a scar, with cyclic pain; this precisely matches abdominal wall endometrioma. R3 is broader (abdominal endometriosis) and less specific to the wall location.

rejected.why: Too general; lacks the abdominal wall localization and scar association.
Endometrioma is a cystic lesion; here histology shows glands and stroma, and location is specified as abdominal wall.
